title: Tea
tagline: Archive social media platforms to decentralized storage networks
description: This project liberates the users from the shackles of big tech. Starting with backing up Twitter, the twitter user bundle is extracted on the browser and user has the ability to redact information before uploading the project to decentralized storage networks. Private information is removed before saving.
how_its_made: Utilize scaffold eth for front end and smart contract deployment. React is used for the view along.  Docker images for swarm and xdai were used in development for storage.  Puppeteer framework used for creating test cases that can ramp up load. AWS EKS service utilized to simulate nodes.
